[description]
In the upcoming college football game, scheduled for September 24 at 7:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Liberty and Coastal Carolina combine to score 36 or more points in this game.

If the combined total is less than 36, this market will resolve to "Under".

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
